info.longBusinessSummary: MPI Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, repairs, imports/exports, and trades in semiconductor manufacturing and testing equipment in Taiwan, China, the United States, Singapore, Korea, and internationally. It offers probe cards comprising cantilever, kestrel, FCB, EVS, and osprey probe cards. The company also provides probe systems, RF and high-power characterization platforms, photonics automation, high bandwidth memory test, and thermal technologies. In addition, it offers celadon systems, including multiprobe, high performance cables, production wafer level burn-in, 3KV high voltage test, cryogenic, multisite testing-rail system, parametric test, wafer level reliability and burn-in, and modeling and characterization services. Further, the company provides MPI Thermal Cycling Test Systems for semiconductor, automotive, aerospace/defence, electronic test, fiber optics, advanced technology telecommunications, and sensors; and accessories, such as thermal end effectors, hi-temp silicon insulation foam rubber and non-conductive shrouds, thermal glass caps, flex-hose extenders in a range of lengths, and hood and clamshell style thermal test chamber. It serves automotive, datacenters, aerospace, and emerging computing platforms. MPI Corporation was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.
